errors.card_has_history: This credit card has purchases or invoice payments and cannot be deleted; archive it instead
errors.pending_operations_decision_required: This credit card has planned recurring charges; choose whether to keep or cancel them before archiving it
errors.purchase_not_deletable: This purchase is already billed on a closed invoice or has refunds; refund it instead
errors.purchase_category_kind: A credit card purchase needs an expense category
errors.installments_exceed_amount: The amount is too small to split into this many installments
errors.refund_exceeds_purchase: The refund exceeds what is left to refund on this purchase
errors.refund_before_purchase: A refund cannot be dated before its purchase
errors.refund_not_deletable: This refund is on a closed invoice and cannot be deleted
errors.payment_exceeds_outstanding: The payment exceeds the outstanding amount of the invoice
errors.historical_settlement_not_before_opening: A historical settlement must be dated before the opening balance date of the account and not in the future. For a later date, record a normal invoice payment
errors.historical_settlement_duplicate: This historical settlement is already recorded for this invoice
